==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Giuseppe:''' One day, you'll see that my mind is much more profound than those who just know how to put on a show.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Giuseppe:''' I'm admiring the performers rehearsing an opera on the water stage. Look, Director Aynor is giving them notes.
:'''Giuseppe:''' I hope tonight's performance goes perfectly...
:'''Giuseppe:''' The director is right. The lead actress needs to pour more emotion into that scene.
:{{DIcon}} You seem quite familiar with this play.
:'''Giuseppe:''' Yes, but I still want to see it again. That's the magic of the Odyssey Opera House.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean?
:'''Giuseppe:''' A stage built on water is bound to have spontaneous moments of romance.
:'''Giuseppe:''' You'll get it once you see it—when the show reaches its peak, even the ocean seems to cheer for the amazing performance.
:'''Giuseppe:''' You never know if you'll be met with crashing waves or schools of fish leaping across the stage today.
:'''Giuseppe:''' The actors dance in harmony with the ever-changing scenery, perfectly matched with fleeting landscapes.
:'''Giuseppe:''' A classic performance gets to continuously evolve and be re-imagined in nature, and that's what makes this opera house so enchanting.
{{Dialogue End}}
